title: A yearly tax paid from its own place, bills in some months, a one-off, pay on the last working day (review v3 situation 9, decision H7)
story: One bank, set up Sat 1 May 2027 with 600,000, of which 300,000 is kept in a car tax place. Pay of 250,000 lands on the last working day of each month. Car tax of 400,000 is due every 31 May (moved later), paid from the car tax place; the place refills for next year after each payment (E5). Property tax of 100,000 is due on 15 June and 15 September. A one-off sofa of 50,000 is due on 20 May. Rent of 80,000 on the 27th, moved later. No holidays are listed for this test. Every amount is made up.

events.note: 300,000 from the car tax place, 100,000 from the rest of the bank

asks.question: days_to_next_pay
asks.note: Mon 31 May is the last working day of May. Before H7 the model had no last working day rule: no next pay.

asks.question: due_before_next_pay
asks.note: The car tax lands on the pay day, so it is not before the pay.

asks.question: safe_to_spend
asks.why: 600,000 (Bank today) - 300,000 (Car tax place, kept in it) - 50,000 (Sofa 20 May) - 80,000 (Rent 27 May) + 250,000 (Pay 31 May) - 100,000 (Car tax 31 May: 400,000, of which 300,000 comes from its place) - 100,000 (Property tax 15 Jun) - 80,000 (Rent 28 Jun) = 140,000
asks.note: Paid from its place, the car tax is not taken off twice. The walk runs to the second next pay, 30 Jun.

asks.question: place
asks.why: 300,000 (set aside) - 300,000 (car tax 31 May, paid from it up to what it held) = 0
asks.note: Refill (E5): it starts again for next year's car tax.

asks.question: safe_to_spend
asks.note: Nothing is kept for the car tax any more, so nothing more comes off for it.
